title: RunRequest
description: What dyno asks a driver to run.

idle_after_ms.description: The game frame is idle after this long with no new requests.

launch_url.description: The full launch URL, query string included. It never goes into a result.

spins.description: Demo spins to play after load (Phase 2). Null for a load-and-idle run.

timeout_ms.description: The driver stops and sends an error after this long.

HostProfile.description:
How a host page embeds a game, and the device facts the static formulas use. Reels is the
first host profile. It holds no assumed cost: the device run measures those.

active_message.description: The message the host sends when the game becomes active, such as `reels:active`.

device_scale_factor.description: The device pixel ratio the run forces. The reference iPhone's is 3.

pcm_low_rate_hz.description:
The lower context rate that fixes suggest. The measure ids name 24 kHz, so a change needs
new ids.

pcm_rate_hz.description:
The audio context's sample rate on the reference iPhone. Decoded audio is held at this
rate. The measure ids name 48 kHz, so a change needs new ids.

ready_message.description: The message the game sends when it is ready, such as `reels:ready`.

ready_within_ms.description: The contract's limit on time to the ready message.

version.description: Bumps when any value below changes.

viewport.description: The game frame's size in CSS pixels.

webgpu.description:
Whether the reference browser has WebGPU on. When it is off, a game that asks for WebGPU
gets WebGL.

Scenario.description: The harness scenario of a browser run.

oneOf.description: The game alone in a fresh harness page (Phase 1).
The harness page after 10 earlier games (Phase 2).
One game active while the next one preloads (Phase 2).
